pages.text: Servers and singleplayer worlds can enable $(thing)Start in Atum$() in $(item)atum-common.toml$(). New players then start in the dimension. The default starter structure is a small tent. The separate $(thing)Create Atum Portal$() option supplies an exit pool.

pages.title: Shelter and Respawn
pages.text: With Start in Atum enabled, death without a usable personal spawn returns you to a safe surface near Atum’s shared spawn. A valid personal spawn still works. With default settings, use a bed to set your own spawn and keep track of your portal.
